summary: Iteration 6 - Validated the ingestion module (CSV import) end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_ingestion.py with 26 new pytest cases covering POST /api/import/csv, GET /api/import/status, GET /api/import/status/{id}, validation, defaults, BOM/UTF-8, file-size cap, source resolution, auth, and a regression smoke set. ALL 111 tests pass (85 carry-over + 26 new) in ~19s. Module info /api/modules/ingestion now correctly reports status='active' with capabilities.csv_import='live' and capabilities.scheduled_jobs='planned'. Default source resolution falls back to the seeded Hansen Global Forest Change DataSource (type='csv'). UTF-8 BOM, header case-insensitivity, optional confidence (default 0.8) and detected_at (default now) all work. Row-level errors produce status='partial' with per-row field+message+row_number. File-level errors (missing required cols, non-UTF-8, bad source_id, file >5MB) return appropriate statuses (failed/404/413). Per-row latitude/longitude/affected_area_ha/confidence bounds enforced. detected_at parses both 'Z' and '+00:00'. Events created via import carry metadata.import_job_id linking back to the job and join source_name correctly. /api/events, /events/recent, /data-sources, /notifications, /alerts (legacy), /auth/me all still work. Frontend was NOT modified per instructions; local frontend serves the ForestWatch login page and renders correctly (public preview URL is behind the same Emergent infra 'Preview Unavailable' overlay seen in iter5 — environment/infra, not a code defect).

minor.issue: Carry-over: returns 200 with not_found payload instead of 404.

frontend_issues.infra_note: Public preview URL shows the 'Preview Unavailable!!! Our Agent is resting after inactivity' Emergent overlay (same as iter5). Local frontend (localhost:3000) serves the ForestWatch login UI fine; ForestWatch was NOT modified in this iteration per the request.

action_items: (None blocking) Ingestion module is correctly implemented and fully covered.
(Optional, carry-over) Make GET /api/modules/{name} return 404 when module missing.
(Optional, carry-over) Require auth on /events/event-types and /data-sources/types for uniformity.
critical_code_review_comments: csv_importer.import_csv enforces MAX_FILE_BYTES BEFORE creating the ImportJob — correct ordering avoids polluting the jobs collection with oversized-file noise (AppError 413 file_too_large).
validate_header normalizes lower+strip, so headers like ' Title , COUNTRY ' are accepted — verified.
validate_row uses a single normalization dict for the row keys and reports per-field errors (field, row_number, message) with the raw row preserved — excellent for client-side debugging.

Optional column logic: confidence defaults to 0.8 ONLY when the cell is blank (validate_row leaves it None, importer applies the default at ForestEventCreate construction). detected_at empty -> ParsedRow.detected_at is None and ForestEventCreate falls back to its default (now). Verified.
Status transition is correct: empty/invalid file -> 'failed'; 0 success -> 'failed'; some success + some errors -> 'partial'; all success -> 'completed'.
Each created event carries metadata={'imported_from': filename, 'import_job_id': job.id} — confirmed retrievable via /api/events. Allows downstream cleanup and audit.
_resolve_default_source_id queries sources.find_one({'type':'csv'}) and raises AppError 'missing_csv_source' if absent (400). Good defensive coding.
POST /api/import/csv correctly uses Form(...) for source_id (multipart), NOT a query string — verified via -F form-data test.
ImportJobPublic serialization excludes Mongo _id (uses .id from BaseDocument). No leakage observed in /status endpoints.
list_recent uses sort created_at DESC (verified in tests). limit Query parameter has ge=1/le=100 validation.
GET /api/import/status/{job_id} raises NotFoundError properly mapped to 404 — verified.
Unauth requests to /import/csv and /import/status correctly return 401 (cookie-based auth dependency).
Non-UTF-8 file detection uses utf-8-sig decode in a try/except — surfaces a clear 'File is not valid UTF-8' message AND marks the job failed (not 500). Verified.
Module info /api/modules/ingestion now correctly transitioned from 'planned' -> 'active' with the two capability flags.

Synchronous import is appropriate for the 10k row cap; the MAX_ROWS guard breaks the loop and records a row-cap error — not directly tested here (would require 10001 rows) but the code path is simple and obviously correct.

Suggestion (minor, not blocking): consider exposing the row_number=0 file-level error with a stable 'field' marker (e.g., 'file' or '__header__') instead of None, so frontends can group/filter cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke - login page renders; FE intentionally untouched)

seed_data_creation: Tests upload small ephemeral CSVs and best-effort delete created events via /api/events/{id} keyed on metadata.import_job_id. Import job documents themselves are intentionally left in import_jobs (audit log).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (111 tests, ~19s). New test file is /app/backend/tests/test_ingestion.py. Classes: TestModuleInfo, TestAuth (401), TestSuccessfulImport (happy/defaults/optional cols/+00:00/case-insensitive header/BOM), TestSourceSelection (explicit/default/404 on bad id), TestValidationErrors (missing cols/row-level/bounds/non-UTF8/413), TestStatusEndpoints (list newest-first, limit param, by-id, 404), TestRegressionSmoke. KEY ASSERTIONS: (1) POST /api/import/csv is multipart with file (UploadFile) + optional source_id (Form, NOT query). (2) Status transitions: completed/partial/failed. (3) metadata.import_job_id links events to job for downstream cleanup. (4) Missing required columns produces ONE row_number=0 error whose message lists EACH missing column name (test asserts each one is present). (5) Non-UTF-8 produces 'File is not valid UTF-8' message text; assert substring 'not valid UTF-8'. (6) 5MB+1 byte body returns HTTP 413. (7) /api/modules/ingestion reports status='active' with capabilities {csv_import:'live', scheduled_jobs:'planned'}.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. The ingestion module (csv_importer + validation + scheduler scaffold + import_routes) is implemented correctly and matches the request spec exactly. Frontend was not touched; the public preview infra overlay seen during the FE smoke is unchanged from iteration 5 and is not a code defect.
